basic_details.short_information: Uttarakhand Ayurved University (UAU) has announced vacancy for the Vice-Chancellor post on a contract basis for a term of three years from the date of joining or up to the age limit prescribed by statutes, with a maximum age limit of 65 years. The pay is as per the University Act and UGC norms, along with salary and allowances as admissible under the University Act, Statutes, and State Government guidelines. Exhibiting highest level of competence, integrity, morals, and institutional commitment in the field of AYUSH education.

selection_process: Applications received are evaluated by a Search and Selection Committee. The committee assesses candidates based on their curriculum vitae
and a comprehensive 3-year vision statement. The maximum age of the applicant at the time of recommendation by the Search Committee shall not exceed 65 years.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official university website at https://ayurved.uk.gov.in.

Fill out all sections completely and attach self-attested copies of required testimonials, age proof, comprehensive 3-year vision statement, No Objection Certificate (NOC), and Vigilance Clearance Certificate.
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form.
Place the application in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for the Post of Vice-Chancellor, UAU".

Send the completed application form along with all annexures and supporting documents via Registered or Speed Post to the following address: Director, Ayurvedic and Unani services Uttarakhand, Danda Lakhond, Near I.T. Park, P.O. Gujrada, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248001 on or before 06 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: No vigilance inquiry, departmental inquiry, or legal proceedings shall be pending against the applicant at the time of submission and during the selection process. No case or legal proceeding shall have been instituted against the applicant before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India or any Hon'ble High Court, and all relevant litigation must be disclosed. Incomplete applications, applications received after the due date, or those without mandatory endorsements (NOC and Vigilance Clearance) will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. The Search Committee reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacancy without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A distinguished academician, scholar of repute, and visionary with a distinguished academic record including a Ph.D. or P.G. degree in any subject in AYUSH or related disciplines/sciences from a recognized University/Institution. Exhibiting highest level of competence, integrity, morals, and institutional commitment in the field of AYUSH education. Minimum of ten (10) years of experience as a Professor in a University system (for candidates applying from teaching background). Or equivalent experience in reputed research and/or academic administrative organization (for candidates applying from research organisation and/or academic administration background). Proven administrative acumen and leadership experience in senior academic management roles (such as Dean, Director, Registrar, HOD, or Syndicate/Senate member) with a track record of institutional development, financial management, and fostering academic excellence. Maximum age limit of the applicant at the time of recommendation by the Search Committee shall not exceed 65 years (as prescribed under the Uttarakhand State University norms).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive remuneration as per the Uttarakhand Ayurved University Act, 2009, and State Government norms as adopted from UGC. Salary and allowances are admissible under the University Act, Statutes, and State Government guidelines. content_sections.heading: UAU Vice-Chancellor Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide strategic leadership for the growth, modernization, and global positioning of Ayurveda and integrative medicine. Forge strategic collaborations with national and international research organizations, healthcare institutions, and traditional medicine bodies. Enhance clinical infrastructure, hospital services, academic curricula, and digital governance within the university ecosystem.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAU Vice-Chancellor
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official university website at https://ayurved.uk.gov.in. Fill out all sections completely and attach self-attested copies of required testimonials, age proof, comprehensive 3-year vision statement, No Objection Certificate (NOC), and Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form. Place the application in a sealed envelope superscribed "Application for the Post of Vice-Chancellor, UAU". Send the completed application form along with all annexures and supporting documents via Registered or Speed Post to the following address: Director, Ayurvedic and Unani services Uttarakhand, Danda Lakhond, Near I.T. Park, P.O. Gujrada, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248001 on or before 06 November 2026 by 5:00 PM .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received are evaluated by a Search and Selection Committee. The committee assesses candidates based on their curriculum vitae, qualifications, experience, administrative leadership, and a comprehensive 3-year vision statement. The maximum age of the applicant at the time of recommendation by the Search Committee shall not exceed 65 years.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No vigilance inquiry, departmental inquiry, or legal proceedings shall be pending against the applicant at the time of submission and during the selection process. No case or legal proceeding shall have been instituted against the applicant before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India or any Hon'ble High Court, and all relevant litigation must be disclosed. Incomplete applications, applications received after the due date, or those without mandatory endorsements (NOC and Vigilance Clearance) will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. The Search Committee reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacancy without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for UAU Vice-Chancellor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the post of Vice-Chancellor at Uttarakhand Ayurved University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form by Registered or Speed Post is 06 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. or P.G. degree in any subject in AYUSH or related disciplines/sciences from a recognized University or Institution with a distinguished academic record.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum experience required for UAU Vice-Chancellor?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 10 years of experience as a Professor in a University system or an equivalent position in a reputed research and/or academic administrative organization.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age of the applicant at the time of recommendation by the Search Committee shall not exceed 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for a term of three years from the date of joining or up to the age limit prescribed by statutes.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the UAU Vice-Chancellor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach all required self-attested documents, and send it via Registered or Speed Post to the specified address in Dehradun.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Director, Ayurvedic and Unani services Uttarakhand, Danda Lakhond, Near I.T. Park, P.O. Gujrada, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun - 248001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Enclosures include proof of date of birth, educational certificates from Bachelor's degree onwards, experience certificates, research publications, NOC, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, no-pending-case certificates, and a 300–500 word vision statement.
